structured.approach:
The refusal flagged the git diff line counts and the component tallies in the files-changed table. Neither appears in any source. I re-read the updated task.components input (revision dbdee67), whose content is unchanged, and re-ran `node ci.mjs` and git status to confirm the working tree.

I then rewrote task.code.md in full with these changes:
- The git diff statistics and the CI percentages and line ranges are gone; nothing here comes from a figure that no source holds.
- The files-changed table names each added constant and function from the tool view instead of counting them.
- The CI result is now stated qualitatively: compile passes, the two existing tests pass, there are no static issues, and coverage is below the 90% bar. The only numbers are those in task.components, org.engineering_stack and the tool view.

The code and docs in ap_portal are as shown in the tool view.

claims.text: In src/ap_portal/index.js this step adds the constants RISK_CLASSES, OVERDUE_HEADINGS, HTML_ESCAPES and DECIMAL_STRING, the private functions escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString, riskClass and renderOverdueRow, and the exported renderOverdueRisk. Among the existing lines, it changes only VERSION and module.exports.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or [] and throws TypeError for any other non-array. Otherwise it returns <table class="overdue-risk">, a plain header row (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount), and one <tr class="risk-…"> per row in the given order.

The amount is handled only as a string matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$ and is padded to two decimals as text. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never called on it, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '). The row class is restricted to the four risk values; any other value renders risk-unknown.

VERSION in index.js moved from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0. task.components records 2.3.0 as the version in both index.js and package.json. package.json is outside this step's write scope, so it is not changed here.

The ap_portal CI bar is compile, unit tests, coverage of at least 90%, and static checks: no console.log or eval(, and lines of at most 140 characters. The new code keeps the static checks clean but has no tests yet, so the coverage bar is not met in this step.
This step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so the new unit tests for tests/portal.test.js are not added here.

The brief requires README.md and docs/ to document the module overview and the new functions with signatures, inputs, outputs and examples. This step updated README.md and added docs/ap_portal.md for renderOverdueRisk.
Existing public signatures are kept, and the new behaviour is a new function.

open_questions: CQ-1: CI fails only because coverage is below the 90% bar, until the feat.design B4.5 tests are added. tests/ is outside FE-04's write scope. Is a coverage-only CI failure acceptable for FE-04's automated check?
CQ-2: package.json "version" stays 2.3.0 while VERSION is now 2.4.0. package.json is outside FE-04's write scope, so a later step needs to set it to 2.4.0.
CQ-3: Confirm 2.4.0 as the minor version step (carried from task.components CQ-FE-2).
Carried unchanged: TQ-6, TQ-7, TQ-11, OQ-B8, OQ-B9, OQ-B10, DQ-3, PQ-P7, CQ-FE-1 (styles for the risk-* classes).
structured.summary: STORY-07 is coded in ap_portal: renderOverdueRisk and its private helpers in src/ap_portal/index.js, VERSION 2.4.0, an updated README.md and a new docs/ap_portal.md. Nothing is committed. task.code.md is rewritten in full without the unsupported line counts and CI percentages; changes are named, not counted. CI compiles, the existing tests pass and there are no static issues, but coverage is below the 90% bar. The new tests belong in tests/, which this step cannot write, and package.json's version also needs a later step.
